
## Shell Commands — Token Killer (TK)

Prefix these commands with `tk` for token-efficient output:

```
tk git status / diff / log / blame
tk cargo build / test / clippy
tk dotnet build / test / restore
tk npm install / test / run <script>
tk pytest / pip install
tk ls / tree / grep / rg / find
```

TK strips ANSI noise, collapses progress bars, and shows only test failures.
